description: ACCDB: seed T(ID PK, B BIGINT) with boundary values; run SELECT ID, B, B+1, B/2, B\2, CStr(B) INTO TOut (non-Null rows), SELECT ID, B, B+1 INTO TOutNull (with Null row), and SELECT ID, CStr(B) INTO TOutErr (Null row -> 94, no table). Keeps all pages before/after each SELECT INTO and Close; reads TOut/TOutNull TableDef.Fields and ADO schema.

question.description: ACCDB: seed T(ID PK, B BIGINT) with boundary values; run SELECT ID, B, B+1, B/2, B\2, CStr(B) INTO TOut (non-Null rows), SELECT ID, B, B+1 INTO TOutNull (with Null row), and SELECT ID, CStr(B) INTO TOutErr (Null row -> 94, no table). Keeps all pages before/after each SELECT INTO and Close; reads TOut/TOutNull TableDef.Fields and ADO schema.

args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, B BIGINT)
SELECT ID, B, B + 1 AS BAdd, B / 2 AS BDiv, B \ 2 AS BIdiv, CStr(B) AS BStr INTO TOut FROM T WHERE ID IN (2, 3, 4, 5) ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, B, B + 1 AS BAdd INTO TOutNull FROM T WHERE ID IN (2, 7) ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, CStr(B) AS BStr INTO TOutErr FROM T WHERE ID = 7
SELECT * FROM TOut ORDER BY ID
SELECT * FROM TOutNull ORDER BY ID

SELECT * FROM TOutNull ORDER BY ID
